## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is limited to its intended component.
- [ ] Generated data was not edited by hand.
- [ ] Any curated data changes are identified for maintainer review.
- [ ] Documentation reflects user-visible behavior where applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or sensitive logs are included.
